@{6076f5edb4d0a10cea21aecd|full_name}: that doesn't solve the problem at hand.

Thanks for all the useful feedback! I'm working on implementing changes so that trackers will now default back to the classic spheres that everyone is used to. However there will be a new option to cycle between model types that includes the new axis indicator type, as well as a more rounded box type that still has axis colors on it.
Because the model type will be an option, this also means it will be possible to grab the SteamVR rendermodels as one of the options. (My concerns there were of future/uncommon setups with emulated tracker drivers etc possibly causing problems for a very small subset of people if the rendermodels were the new and only default, but now as an option any users with problems can just pick a different model)
I have these changes working on my end now, but I'm unsure if it'll be through internal review and QA before the next open beta patch. I'll keep you updated once it's in!
i like the models its easier to see the way they are facing for accuracy not like anyone but you can see them. but having a option to change between different models would be nice

Small update: the changes described above are now merged in with what will become the next open beta patch.
